verdict.rationale: Railway lets users set conditions that automatically send notifications to Slack, Discord, or email when met (railway-docs-9). It also has fixed platform automations, such as a preview environment for every pull request (railway-docs-12). However, nothing shows a general user-defined rule engine that triggers arbitrary actions, and the Railway Agent's fixes and PRs are chat-driven rather than documented as event-triggered (railway-docs-25, railway-docs-26). Missing for 10: user-configurable event→action rules beyond alert notifications, webhooks or custom action targets, event-triggered agent remediation, and independent corroboration.
